audit_items.proof_trace: On the standard repayment path, `fee_coin = coin.split(fee)` yields exactly `fee` and `increase_reserve_only` credits it entirely to `cash_reserve`. On the referral path (`repay_flash_loan_increase_referral_qualification`), `referral.track_flash_loan_usage` intentionally splits out `referee_rebates` and `referrer_rebates` before returning the remainder; these splits are stored in the protocol's own `Referral.rebates` bag and are only claimable via `claim_referral_rebates`. This fee-sharing is governed by protocol parameters (`referee_discount_bps`, `referrer_discount_bps`) and is the intended behavior of the referral incentive system.
